name: Kyouken Densetsu Crazy Knuckle
original_name: 狂拳伝説クレイジーナックル
source:
The story is about a martial artist called Zado who wants to be the world's most powerful martial artist. To achieve his dream, he sets out to collect little fragments that will unfold the secret of the ultimate martial arts skill. In order to learn the skill, he has to defeat the people who hold these individual fragments. However, Zado's most-trusted henchmen took all the fragments and learned the ultimate skill himself and defeated Zado. To regain his dignity, Zado has to defeat his henchman in the battle ring.

[Edited from [url=http://densetsu.com/display.php?id=52&style=alphabetical]Anime Densetsu[/url]]
translation:
故事讲述一位名叫Zado的武术家，他立志成为世界最强的武术家。为了实现梦想，他踏上旅程，收集记载着终极武术奥义秘密的碎片。想要习得这门武功，他就必须击败每一位碎片持有者。然而，Zado最信任的手下夺走了全部碎片，独自学会终极奥义并打败了他。为了挽回尊严，Zado必须在擂台上击败这名手下。

[编辑自[url=http://densetsu.com/display.php?id=52&style=alphabetical]Anime Densetsu[/url]]
